units.source_text: 大凡女子，即使名望甚高，且已到了不能隐名的年龄，

en.t: In general, even if a woman was highly renowned and had reached an age when her name could no longer be hidden,

units.source_text: 但在为人女儿而闭居深闺的期间，不去参拜氏神，

en.t: while she remained secluded in the inner chambers as someone's daughter, it was acceptable for her not to visit her clan deity,

units.source_text: 不把姓名公表于世，亦无不可。

en.t: and there was no harm in keeping her name from being made public.

units.source_text: 因此玉鬘糊里糊涂地度送了过去的岁月。

en.t: For that reason, Tamakazura had passed the years in a vague and bewildered way.

units.source_text: 但如今源氏发心送她入宫，则以源氏冒充藤原氏，

en.t: But now that Genji had resolved to send her to court, passing her off through Genji would mean pretending she belonged to the Fujiwara clan,

units.source_text: 便要违背春日神的意旨。

en.t: which would go against the will of the Kasuga deity.

units.source_text: 所以此事毕竟不能隐瞒到底。

en.t: Therefore, this matter could not be concealed to the very end after all.

units.source_text: 更有讨厌的事：外人以为冒领女儿，别有用意，

en.t: There was something even more troublesome: outsiders might think he had falsely claimed another man's daughter for some ulterior purpose,

units.source_text: 因而恶名流传于后世，实甚可虑。

en.t: and it would be deeply worrying if such an evil reputation were handed down to later generations.

units.source_text: 倘是身份低微的人，则照现今流行的习惯，把姓氏改换，事甚容易。

en.t: If she were someone of low rank, it would be quite easy, following the current custom, simply to change her family name.

units.source_text: 但源氏家里未便如此。

en.t: But in Genji's household, that could not conveniently be done.

units.source_text: 他左思右想之后，终于下了决心：“父女之缘毕竟是不能断绝的。

en.t: After thinking the matter over from every side, he finally made up his mind: "The bond between father and daughter cannot be severed after all.

units.source_text: 既然如此，还不如由我自动告知她父亲吧。”

en.t: Since that is so, it would be better for me to tell her father myself."

units.source_text: 便写一封信给内大臣，请他在着裳仪式中担任结腰之职。

en.t: He therefore wrote a letter to the Minister of the Interior, asking him to perform the waist-tying role at her coming-of-age ceremony.

units.source_text: 可是太君从去年冬天起，患病在床，至今尚未见愈，

en.t: However, the grand lady had been ill in bed since the previous winter and had still not recovered,

units.source_text: 内大臣心绪不宁，未便参与典礼，辞谢了源氏的请求。

en.t: so the Minister of the Interior, too troubled in spirit to take part in the ceremony, declined Genji's request.

units.source_text: 夕雾中将也昼夜在三条邸服侍外祖母，无心顾问其他事情。

en.t: Lieutenant General Yugiri was also attending his maternal grandmother day and night at the Sanjo residence and had no mind for other affairs.

units.source_text: 时机不佳，源氏颇感为难。

en.t: The timing was poor, and Genji felt quite at a loss.

units.source_text: 他想：“世事无常，万一太君病亡，玉鬘这孙女应有丧服，

en.t: He thought, "The world is uncertain. If the grand lady should die of her illness, Tamakazura, as her granddaughter, ought to wear mourning,

units.source_text: 若装作不知，则罪孽深重。

en.t: and if we pretend not to know, the sin would be grave.

units.source_text: 我还不如当她在世之时将此事表白了吧。”

en.t: I would do better to reveal the matter while she is still alive."

units.source_text: 他打定主意，便赴三条邸问病。

en.t: Having made up his mind, he went to the Sanjo residence to inquire after her illness.
